Flight time from Kathmandu to Sukilumba Airport is about one hour. [ 3 ] History [ edit ] According to The Rising Nepal , constructions on the airport first began in 2011. [ 4 ] In February 2015, construction ground to a halt as the project ran out of funds. [ 5 ] In 2018, the first test flight landed at the airport. [ 6 ] However, due to insufficient funds, the further construction of the airport was delayed. [ 7 ] In 2021, Civil Aviation Authority of Nepal deemed the airport to be ready for operation. [ 8 ] At the time of opening, the airport is served without a terminal building . Another test flight by Nepal Airlines was carried out on 9 February 2022. [ 9 ] The airport was opened on 13 February 2022 [ 10 ] with flights by Tara Air , whereas Nepal Airlines planned to operate flights but these plans did not yet materialize. [ 11 ] Facilities [ edit ] The airport resides at an elevation of 1,893 feet (577 m) above mean sea level . It has one runway which is 670 metres (2,198 ft) in length.
